# BG Welsh LLC

> Veteran-owned, family-owned excavation, concrete and site work contractor in Franklin, Nebraska 68939, established 2016. Insured for FEMA work, with completed FEMA storm recovery work and public project experience, including site work on an FSA office. Takes federal, state, county and city work, plus farm, ranch and commercial jobs.

- Contact: Gina Welsh, call or text (308) 470-1254
- Location: Franklin, Nebraska 68939
- Service area: about two hours of driving from Franklin, covering south-central Nebraska and northern Kansas (Kearney, Grand Island, Hastings, Lexington)
- Owners: Brian and Gina Welsh
- Ownership: veteran owned, family owned
- Insurance: insured for FEMA work
- NAICS: 238910 site preparation; 238110 poured concrete; 237110 water and sewer lines; 561730 landscaping; 237310 highway, street and bridge; 237990 other heavy and civil; 236220 commercial and institutional building

## Services

- Storm and FEMA recovery: debris cleanup, culverts, drainage, emergency site and road repair
- Site prep, excavation and trenching
- Water lines, water line repair, stock waterers and bottomless tanks
- Concrete pads, feedlot runways and retaining walls
- Gravel and grading
- Lawn sprinkler systems
- Public and commercial site work
